imageSearchNotes: Previously 0 screenshots (2026-09-11 note: 'No screenshot media exists in the current Microsoft Learn docs source for the Package Configuration Wizard dialog pages' — re-verified 2026-10-03, still true). tutorialgateway.org runs separate walkthroughs for each of the five configuration types, each with its own screenshot series; most of their Select Configuration Type captures have hand-drawn red boxes (e.g. image 14 on the environment-variable page, image 6 on the SQL Server page, images 2/3/11 showing the SSIS-menu and Organizer steps), which were skipped per policy. Images 10, 13, and the Registry Entry walkthrough's image 12 are clean, unaltered captures and were used instead — between them they show the Organizer's Enable checkbox and the Configuration type dropdown holding two different real values (XML configuration file, Registry entry), which is enough to demonstrate the dropdown genuinely offers multiple configuration sources without relying on any annotated image.
